issue_context.title: Angular effect throws "Unsubscription error" when signal is set in finalize operator
comments:
don't you have to add `{allowSignalWrites: true} ` in your effect as a second argument ? because you're writing to the Signal inside an effect which  Angular prevents by default

> Because of these risks, Angular by default prevents you from setting signals in effects. It can be enabled if absolutely necessary by setting the allowSignalWrites flag when you create an effect.

[docs](https://angular.dev/guide/signals#use-cases-for-effects)

What is going on here is that the `onCleanup` function runs _outside_ of the `untracked` block of the effect. You could untrack the actual cleanup (https://stackblitz.com/edit/stackblitz-starters-msxq4e?file=src%2Fmain.ts) but I think we should do so by default.
